_comment: SET INDICES source of truth. Written at inception by the build session (Aug 24 2026); appended weekly by the Monday trend-scan STEP 3.6 re-mark. SCHEMA per index: base (always 100.00), inception, divisor (current), divisorLog[{date, before, after, why}], universe[{num, name, rarity}] (ALL slots in scope, priced or not), basket[{num, name, rarity, price, basis, asOf}] (only cards with sourced SOLD reads), history[{date, level, basketValue, divisor, priced, note}]. MATH: level = sum(basket prices) / divisor. INCLUSION (a universe card gets its first sourced sold comp): newDivisor = oldDivisor * (basketValueAfter / basketValueBefore) -- the level MUST be identical before and after; log it in divisorLog. RULES: sold comps only, dated + attributed, never asks, never estimated; base/inception/history rows are immutable; an index is a measurement, not a call. ADDENDUM Aug 24: universeComplete=false means the secret-tier enumeration is partial (API down at build) — STEP 3.6 must complete the universe list from pokemontcg.io before or during the next re-mark.
